digest.component_or_area: CI/CD infrastructure and test suite performance
propositions: Every CI test and fixture over one second requires an exhaustive audit mapping each cost to its unique reachable failure mode, faster overlapping coverage, prior ticket decisions, and safe remediation options.

The three most recent successful Gerrit Verify runs (31903956917, 31900256967, 31900214367) average 24m58s with no individual pytest phase exceeding 30s, indicating macOS and Ubuntu jobs are within target completion windows.

Gerrit 1817 merged a proven route removing 19 OS/Python-invariant repository-policy nodes from macOS and Ubuntu 3.11/3.12 while retaining them in Ubuntu 3.13, saving approximately 8s macOS and 24.84 aggregate runner-seconds with no new job/setup/runner cost.

External analyzers, Git store/locks/concurrency, import/packaging, partial clone, and signature/identity lifecycle tests preserve real platform seams and unique failure modes that cannot be safely mocked without loss of confidence.
No new macOS/Ubuntu shard or additional runner allocation is recommended until equivalence via fault-seeding and platform-specific behavior analysis proves a phase is safely routeable across cells.
